official.application_cycle: 4th edition (2026); applications open 01 October 2026 at 14h and close 13 November 2026 at 17h
official.status_note: Applications for the 4th edition opened on 1 October 2026 at 14h and close on 13 November 2026 at 17h; the Call Notice was republished on 8 October 2026 with an amendment to section 2 (Target Applicants and Eligibility).
official.tuition_coverage_note: No tuition figure is published; the call competitively funds individual R&D projects executed by the beneficiary R&D unit, not degree tuition.
official.funding_period: per project, up to 18 months of development
benefits: Maximum funding of EUR 50,000 per project
Maximum duration of 18 months of project development
Total budget allocation of EUR 1.6 million for this edition
Possibility of associating other human and/or material resources, according to the funding available and the planned execution time
Competitive funding of individual R&D projects in all scientific domains
eligibility: National, foreign and stateless researchers may apply, with the commitment of the host institution, meeting all requirements cumulatively at the deadline of the application submission period
Be an integrated doctoral member of an R&D unit, or hold a contractual link with a State laboratory

Have benefited from parental leave, including for adoption, of 120 days or more (shared parental leave, including for adoption: at least 72 days taken exclusively or shared), with the minimum number of days reached between 3 June 2025 and 1 October 2026 inclusive, regardless of the leave start or end dates

Not eligible: applicants who are beneficiaries of projects funded or recommended for funding by FCT as PI (IR) or Co-PI (Co-IR) as of 1 June 2027 (reference date amended from 1 September 2026 in the notice republished on 8 October 2026)

Not admitted: applications previously selected for funding by FCT or other funding agencies, and multiple applications sharing all or part of the work plan, within this notice or across notices with overlapping submission periods
requirements: Applications must be submitted by filling in a dedicated form, in English, electronically on myFCT
The application must be filed with the commitment of the host institution
Applications open 01 October 2026 at 14h and close 13 November 2026 at 17h (Portuguese time)

Researchers holding a scholarship contract may prove parental leave with the statement of suspension of the research activities funded by that scholarship, issued by the contracting institution; for FCT scholarships this may be replaced by simply indicating the scholarship reference
The budget must be justified against the submitted research plan; expenses declared insufficiently justified by the evaluation panel are not accepted for the project
documents: Application form completed in English on myFCT
Proof of parental or adoption leave; for scholarship holders, the statement of suspension of research activities issued by the contracting institution, or simply the FCT scholarship reference
CIENCIAVITAE curriculum (a CIENCIAVITAE guide is published with the call)
Research/work plan with a justified budget
Ethics self-assessment where applicable (Ethics Self-Assessment Guide published with the call)
selection_criteria: Scientific quality, innovative character and feasibility of the proposed research plan
Merit of the candidate and fit of their profile with the research plan
Impact of the project's execution on the development of the researcher's career
Sufficient justification of the expenses essential to carrying out the project (insufficient justification affects the evaluation)
coverage: Competitive funding of individual R&D projects in all scientific domains
Maximum of EUR 50,000 per project, for a maximum of 18 months of development

The host institution carries out the expenses it considers essential for the execution of the approved project; no fixed overhead rate is applied, but necessary basic operating expenses may be included
Funding is granted to the beneficiary entity: R&D units funded under the FCT Multi-Year Funding Programme, State laboratories, and Associate Laboratories with approved status
application_method: Confirm you meet the three cumulative eligibility requirements at the deadline of the application submission period
Obtain the commitment of the host institution
Prepare proof of the qualifying parental leave (or the equivalent statement of suspension / FCT scholarship reference)
Complete the dedicated form in English on myFCT
Submit during the published period: 01 October 2026 (14h) to 13 November 2026 (17h)
official.application_route: Online only: complete the dedicated English form on the myFCT portal ('Iniciar candidatura'), with the commitment of the host institution.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to national, foreign and stateless researchers, with the commitment of the host institution
official.international_eligibility: Yes - foreign and stateless researchers are eligible
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: None: individual R&D projects in all scientific domains
official.research_requirement: An original and innovative research idea, pursued through a research plan whose scientific quality, feasibility and budget justification are evaluated, together with the fit of the candidate's profile
official.description: The FCT launches the 4th edition of the RESTART programme to promote gender equality and equal opportunities through the competitive funding of individual R&D projects in all scientific fields, when carried out by researchers who have recently taken parental leave, including adoption leave.
official.english_requirement: The proposal must be submitted by filling in a dedicated form, in English, available electronically on myFCT; no IELTS/TOEFL score is published.

not_confirmed: living stipend or per-month amount for the researcher (the grant is a project grant held by the beneficiary R&D unit)
provisional results date for the 4th edition

verification.notes: Amount (EUR 50,000 per project), 18-month cap, EUR 1.6M budget, eligibility rules, deadline, documents and evaluation criteria taken from the FCT 4th-edition call page, the RESTART programme page and the RESTART FAQs on fct.pt; all pages were fetched successfully on the first attempt.

applicant_utility.summary: RESTART is a project grant of up to EUR 50,000 for up to 18 months of research, awarded to your Portuguese host R&D unit rather than paid to you, so treat it as seed money to rebuild a research line after parental leave, not as income. The window that counts is the parental-leave days actually taken between 3 June 2025 and 1 October 2026; the leave start and end dates themselves are irrelevant. With roughly 31 projects funded per edition from a EUR 1.6 million envelope, the English-language research plan and its budget justification carry most of the decision weight.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Doctoral researchers, including foreign nationals and stateless residents, embedded in a Portuguese FCT-funded R&D unit or State laboratory, who took a qualifying parental or adoption leave inside the 3 June 2025 - 1 October 2026 window and can secure their host institution's commitment.
application_readiness_checklist: Count the parental/adoption leave days that fall between 3 June 2025 and 1 October 2026 and confirm you clear 120 days (72 if shared) inside that window; email restart@fct.pt if the count is borderline and request a phone or videoconference review
Confirm your unit is funded under the FCT Multi-Year Funding Programme (or is a State laboratory or approved Associate Laboratory) and obtain its formal written commitment to host the project early

Check you are not PI or Co-PI of any FCT-funded or FCT-recommended project at the 1 June 2027 reference date, and that your work plan does not overlap any other FCT application with an open submission window
Build the budget line by line against the work plan: salaries for staff already under contract (including you as IR), bonuses, gratuities and salary supplements cannot be charged
Draft the research plan and the English form in the first weeks of the six-week window, since institutional sign-off is the usual bottleneck
common_rejection_risks: Counting leave days that fall outside 3 June 2025 - 1 October 2026, or assuming leave still being taken after 1 October 2026 qualifies
Being PI or Co-PI on an existing FCT-funded or FCT-recommended project without checking the amended 1 June 2027 reference date
Duplicating all or part of a work plan across this call and another FCT notice with an overlapping submission period
A budget the panel deems insufficiently justified - the expenses FAQ makes this an explicit scoring factor, not a formality
Failing to attach the host institution commitment before the 17:00 Portuguese-time cut-off
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Your own salary and living costs: the grant pays the R&D unit for project execution rather than a personal stipend, and charges for pre-existing employment links are explicitly not justifiable, so you remain dependent on your institutional contract or fellowship for income.
document_audit: Proof of leave must evidence the exact days counted inside the window; a generic HR letter without dates will not demonstrate the 120/72-day threshold
Scholarship holders: the FCT scholarship reference replaces the suspension statement, so quoting a wrong or expired reference breaks the proof
The CIENCIAVITAE and Ethics Self-Assessment guides are published with the call; ignoring them risks a malformed CV or an ethics flag surfacing late
Every budget line needs a written justification tied to the work plan, because unjustified lines are struck even after a funding recommendation
alerts: The call page body still shows the old 1 September 2026 PI/Co-IR exclusion date, while the notice republished on 8 October 2026 moves it to 1 June 2027 - rely on the republished Aviso
The submission window is short (1 October - 13 November 2026) and closes at 17:00 Portuguese time, with no allowance for late institutional approval
The instrument funds only about 31 projects per edition and FCT reports roughly 94% of approved proposals were submitted by women, so expect a highly competitive, demographically skewed pool
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Log in to myFCT, open the RESTART 4th edition form via 'Iniciar candidatura', complete the English form with the research plan and justified budget, attach the leave proof and host commitment, and submit before 13 November 2026, 17:00.
